name: Mordred
title: Vengeful Heir
summary: Bring doom upon Avalon by casting Confusion, Corruptions and devastating damage
lore: The bastard son of King Arthur fought to overthrow his father, and fell at the battle of Camlann. Yet he was taken and restored by Morgan le Fey—said by some to be his mother. Today, driven by his own ambition, by Morgan, and by Chaos itself, he strives to kill Arthur again and to rule over all of Avalon.
archetype_description: Ignore 1% of enemy resistance for each piece of nightweave armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: If a target is under [Confuse] and [Corrupt], remove their [Shield] or [Barrier] before attacking.
Also increase this hero’s Divinity 5% when an enemy is attacked by their ally.
